nvitk.gui.labels.catalog
========================

.. py:module:: nvitk.gui.labels.catalog

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Registry of integer label id → human name maps for GUI label selection.



Classes
-------

.. autoapisummary::

   nvitk.gui.labels.catalog.LabelSchema

Module Contents
---------------

.. py:class:: LabelSchema

   Named label vocabulary (pipeline output or model taxonomy).


   .. py:attribute:: key
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: title
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: group
      :type:  str


   .. py:attribute:: id_to_name
      :type:  Mapping[int, str]


   .. py:attribute:: description
      :type:  str
      :value: ''



   .. py:method:: name_for(label_id: int) -> str | None

      Human name registered for *label_id*, or ``None`` if this schema doesn't have one.



   .. py:method:: display(label_id: int) -> str

      Display string for *label_id*: ``"<name> (<id>)"`` if named, else ``"Label <id>"``.



.. py:function:: all_schemas() -> dict[str, LabelSchema]

   Lazy-built catalog of every registered label schema.


.. py:function:: schema_keys() -> list[str]

   Sorted schema keys (generic first, then pipelines, then TotalSegmentator).


.. py:function:: get_schema(key: str | None) -> LabelSchema | None

   Look up the schema registered under *key* (``"generic"`` or falsy *key* returns the generic
   schema); ``None`` if unregistered.


.. py:function:: schema_for_totalsegmentator_task(task: str) -> str

   Schema key matching a TotalSegmentator CLI task name.


.. py:function:: guess_schema_from_layer(layer: Any | None) -> str | None

   Heuristic schema from layer name or ``nvitk_metadata['source']``.
